problem.title: Binary Search
problem.source: Official LeetCode problem page; Chinese explanation independently paraphrased
facts: Input array is sorted in ascending order and contains unique integers.
Return the target index or -1 if absent.
The required runtime is O(log n).

claims.claim: At the start of each iteration, if target exists, it is inside the closed interval [left,right].
Because nums is ascending, comparing nums[mid] with target safely discards one side including mid.
The interval shrinks by at least half per iteration, giving O(log n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
claims.validation: Binary search recurrence and constant scalar state.
